resources.string: PocketPilot · Drive DeepSeek Harness from your phone
Run tasks on your computer, watch progress and send instructions from your phone.\nThree ways to connect: USB cable, same Wi-Fi, or across networks.

First time? Tap “Scan QR code” — the pairing page on your computer shows a QR code; just scan it, no need to copy any address or token.\n\nAlready plugged in or on the same Wi-Fi? Tap “Enter” and it will find your computer automatically.
Not paired yet — scan the QR code or enter a pairing code first.
Applies to the whole app at once.

Command a live DeepSeek Harness session on your PC right from your phone: launch tasks on the desktop, then follow progress, send instructions and read results on the phone.

• Three connection paths: USB cable, same Wi-Fi, or across networks (Cloudflare tunnel)
• Desktop DSH keeps listening on loopback only — the bridge handles authentication, proxying, keep-alive and reconnection
• Your phone needs no extra app and no root • Independent third-party tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek

If this project helps you, a star on GitHub is much appreciated.
